names.why: Roughly 15 of 33 videos are not walking: run, leap, fall, spin, kneel, lean, dodge, stand still, raise a flag, shift furniture.
Weak for planes, helicopter, paraglider and swimming, but I found no single word that covers water and air better.

notes: No clear misplacement. Odd ones with no better home: 7841 'forwards' (roller coaster, in Voyage), 4703 'raise' (flag) and 5264 'shift' (furniture) in Walking.
